body.x: [Las Vegas, U.S. = Aving News] “CES is a gathering place for many people from all over the world who wish to understand the future. That is why it is a must-come place for startups!”

During our meeting on the 6th in local time at Eureka Park, Venetian Expo Center in Las Vegas, U.S., Yosik Kang, leader of the Seoul Digital Foundation (SDF), highlighted the first-hand experience that CES can offer.

After the pandemic shrank the number of participants from major global businesses and startups in CES 2022, much has changed this year. With about 2,800 businesses from 17 countries participating (40% up from last year), this year’s CES was as alive as it was in years past.
In line with this, SDF has been actively cooperating with Korean startups, even before the opening of CES 2023, reaping results.

Firstly, the organization hosted the “Third Stage Eureka” last July to recruit participants for CES 2023 and screened 10 of them through their IR pitches, which are now attending the event with SDF. Four of them won five CES 2023 Innovation Awards in recognition of their technology, design, and innovation.
In addition, they successfully made purchase agreements on site.

Smartooth Korea (CEO Hojung Son), developer of a home-use oral monitoring device supported by SDF, finalized a device purchase contract worth $101,300 at CES 2023. The startup also won Innovation Awards in the areas of digital health and software mobile app at the event.
Such achievements were made possible, thanks to the backing of SDF Chairman Yosik Kang who actively supported innovators in Seoul.
On the 6th in local time at CES 2023, Aving News was able to meet Chairman Kang who has a strong passion for startups.
Q. Editor-in-Chief Choe: This is the third time that the Seoul Digital Foundation participated in CES. How are you feeling about returning to the world's largest tech exhibition?

A. Chairman Kang: Over the past few years, I have been able to attend CES and watch the exhibitions and the participating companies grow. Although the pandemic slowed it down for a while, the number of participants has increased year by year. Most importantly, the number of Korean companies winning Innovation Awards for their technology and competitiveness at the CTA, the organizer, has increased significantly. This great achievement really means a lot.
Q. Editor-in-Chief Choe: Could you tell us a bit about the Seoul Digital Foundation?

A. Chairman Kang: SDF is a like a “control tower” for the digital transformation of Seoul, the capital of South Korea. We are active in introducing artificial intelligence (AI), metaverse, big data, and other technologies representing the Fourth Industrial Revolution that show what and how Seoul does its work. The foundation also supports startups wishing to participate in domestic and international exhibitions such as CES, and has promoted training that minimizes the digital gap between classes.

Q. Editor-in-Chief Choe: At CES 2023, K-Startup Joint Pavilion is operated by Seoul Business Agency, Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development and others. So they are here representing not just Seoul but also the Republic of Korea. So what synergies are we expecting to receive?

A. Chairman Kang: In setting up K-Startup Joint Pavilion, the collaboration between the Seoul Metropolitan Government and the Ministry of SMEs and Startups played a major role. Through this productive collaboration, the foundation as well as businesses are working to create as much value as possible. In fact, five CES participants from the 20 Seoul Digital Foundation partners were honored to win innovation awards. I was very proud that they were recognized for their innovative and iconic attributes among businesses from different industries showcasing their technologies and products.

With nearly 400 Korean companies participating in this year's exhibition, we know that 65% of them are startups. This means that there are many Korean startups equipped with excellent competitiveness, and most of them are very keen to enter overseas markets. I think they have a beneficial influence on each other.

body.cap: Joseph Choe, editor-in-chief of Aving News (left) and Yosik Kang, chairman of Seoul Digital Foundation (right) visiting Smartooth Booth at Eureka Park, Venetian Expo Center in Las Vegas, U.S. on the 6th (local time) | Photo by Aving News

body.x: Q. Editor-in-Chief Choe: I recently heard that the Seoul Digital Foundation achieved favorable results on an international scale from the smart city project.

A. Chairman Kang: We won the Best City Award in the field of urban strategy at the “Smart City Expo World Congress 2022,” the largest international smart city event last year. This achievement was made possible from our fourth trial, following the ones made in 2015, 2016, and 2019. Our dreams quite literally came true by winning this award. It would not be an overstatement to say we felt as if we have won the World Cup.

I believe the foundation's inclusion policy for the digitally disadvantaged contributed to winning the award. At the same time, the fact that “Metaverse Seoul” platform was selected as the best invention in the metaverse field among the “200 Best Inventions of 2022” by Time magazine was a major factor in our winning the award as well.
Q. Editor-in-chief Choe: Such outstanding achievements must mean a lot to the companies that have cooperated with the foundation.

A. Chairman Kang: Absolutely. As a number of cities around the world are competing for this very exceptional honor, the result hugely enhances the status of the city of Seoul around the world. Therefore, I believe it will also be a great help for Seoul-based companies as they seek ways to carry out sales abroad.

Furthermore, we are planning to expand our booth so that it will be much larger for SCWC 2023 than the last time. We are also committed to increasing the participantion rates among districts of Seoul to promote our city’s excellent digital policy to the world.
Q. Editor-in-Chief Choe: What kind of future are you expecting from K-Startup Joint Pavilion at CES 2023?

A. Chairman Kang: Leading industries in the future will require the ability to look ahead into the future of the industry. CES is a gathering place for many people from all over the world who wish to understand this future. New technologies across the field are constantly evolving and universalized. For this process, it's important for businesses to consider and realize how they will commercialize their technology and turn it into a service. That's why I think CES is a place that must be experienced by startups.

The area in which I personally hold my highest expectations is the metaverse field. In particular, I focus on where it is directing by building a new space where human intelligence come together and overcome the limitations of reality. This serves as a vision to improve the quality of human life, and CES, where a variety of visions come together and harmonize, is also an example that humanity needs to follow.

body.cap: Yosik Kang, Chairman of SDF at Eureka Park, Venetian Expo Center in Las Vegas, U.S. on the 6th (local time) | Photo by Aving News

body.x: Q. Editor-in-Chief Choe: Could you say a word for the Seoul businesses here?

A. Chairman Kang: In line with the slogan of CES 2023, “BE IN IT,” I hope that everyone will be able to gain enough insights and create their future by experiencing this event first-hand. I promise that the Seoul Digital Foundation will also spare no effort to help businesses make their way into the global market.
Of course, businesses must also be fully prepared to receive the foundation's assistance. I sincerely hope that the foundation as well as businesses will continue to grow and fulfill our potential.

Meanwhile, CES, the world's largest IT fair, is an exhibition that provides a comprehensive look of the global consumer electronics industry in just one place. It is held annually in Las Vegas in January by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News has annually reported on CES news for the world for 17 consecutive years since 2006, hosting the Best of CES which selects the best innovative products and technologies, and the Best of Made in Korea that chooses the most innovative businesses in South Korea. In addition, the media has delivered breaking news about CES through AVING LIVE.
